title: Microsoft Teams: automatic recording indicator for call queue calls on mobile
summary: Pass with a descriptive gap: Microsoft documents recording, but not transcription, starting when a representative answers. The rollout and controls are supported; licensing and differences between Microsoft's UI and PowerShell documentation need minor clarification.

claims.claim: This Microsoft Teams change concerns the automatic recording indicator for call queue calls on mobile.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording indicator for call queue calls on Mobile

claims.claim: The mobile banner will indicate that recording started automatically on call queue calls automatically recorded by the organization.
claims.quote: The banner will state that recording started automatically and cannot be stopped.

claims.claim: The mobile indicator will say transcription started automatically.
claims.quote: Teams on Mobile will clearly indicate that recording and transcription have started automatically and cannot be stopped.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Automatic Recording for Call Queue records inbound calls when a representative answers.
claims.quote: When enabled, all inbound call queue calls are automatically recorded when a representative (agent) answers.

claims.claim: Automatic transcription starts when a representative answers the call queue call.
claims.quote: Searched: call queue transcription starts answers. Opened aa-cq-plan-recording and aa-cq-setup-call-queue-template-recording-automatic. Only recording has a documented answer-time start; the roadmap and notice do not specify transcription's start time.
claims.fix: Replace 'Recording and transcription start automatically when a representative answers' with 'Recording starts automatically when a representative answers'. Keep the separately supported statement that the banner reports automatic recording and transcription that representatives cannot stop.

claims.quote: All recordings are stored in SharePoint.

claims.claim: Automatic call queue transcripts are stored in the SharePoint location defined by the recording template.
claims.quote: An automatic recording template for Call Queue defines where, in SharePoint, recordings and transcripts will be stored

claims.claim: Authorized users access automatic call queue recordings through Queues App.
claims.quote: Shared Call History must also be enabled on the call queue so that authorized users and representatives can access the recordings in Queues App.

claims.claim: Representatives can be granted permission to access their queue's recordings through Queues App.
claims.quote:
Representatives can be given permission to view the queue's recordings and transcriptions.
    - Queues App is required for authorized users and representatives.

claims.claim: The licensing model for the banner-only change is unknown.
claims.quote:
At least one Teams Phone license to enable Teams Phone Agent, Auto Attendant, and Call Queue services.

claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included'. Replace the first sentence of licensing.notes and the first Cost and licensing paragraph with 'This banner-only update is within the existing Call Queue service, whose base licensing requires at least one Teams Phone license and a free Microsoft Teams Phone Resource Account license for each resource account; no banner-specific licence or meter is published.' Retain the existing recording and Queues App licensing qualifications and cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/aa-cq-reference-prerequisites-licensing.

claims.claim: The underlying automatic call queue recording feature requires conference mode.

Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/aa-cq-reference-prerequisites-licensing, which says 'Use Microsoft 365 security groups to assign representatives to the queue.'
